title: HDR+
description: A modpack that brings optimizations to boost performance and output HDR with patched shaders.
body:
HDR+ is a Vanilla+ modpack that brings HDR output to Minecraft using [rrtt217's HDR mod](https://modrinth.com/mod/rrtt217-s-hdr-mod)
# IMPORTANT
### **This modpack does NOT come with the shaderpacks needed to fully experience this pack.** 
~~See XgarhontX's temporary patches for HDR output and tonemapping on select shaderpacks with support for this mod:~~ [Shader Patch Table](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/1WgOqKED2FxC11-2oyW4aBIyl8tAHo-8WJ7JPxhYAO2Q/edit?gid=0#gid=0)

## See [GitHub](https://github.com/rrtt217/Minecraft-HDR-Mod/wiki/HDR-Shaderpacks) for shaders compatible with HDR Mod.

> Currently, these shaders are supported with the HDR mod:
- Bliss
- Complimentary - Unbound/Reimagined
- Photon
